Home.promiseText: CareLoop never diagnoses, prescribes, or changes medication. Result status and escalation come from deterministic rules and stored reference ranges, never an AI opinion.
Home.privacyText: Sensitive records are encrypted and access is audited. This demonstration accepts synthetic data only.
Home.stageText: Explore reports, trends, reminders, and human clinic review with a fictional account. Reference ranges are unverified engineering fixtures.
Home.notice: CareLoop supports understanding and conversations with your care team. It does not replace a clinician. Discuss your results with your doctor.
Home.footer: Thoughtfully built for patients and the people who care for them.
